newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks jump in early morning, helped by Dow.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks jump in early morning, helped by Dow.

text.p: Tokyo stock prices jumped in early morning trade on Tuesday, helped by the continuation overnight of a rally in the New York Dow Industrials, brokers said.
But they said the market lacked strong incentives to push up the key Nikkei average sharply.

Half an hour after the beginning of Tokyo's morning session, the benchmark Nikkei 225 average had gained 126.28 points or 0.60 percent to 21,191.36. In the stock futures market, the key December futures contract was 130 points higher at 21,230.
"The New York market remained bullish and it will keep on underpinning the market," said a broker at a major Japanese securities house.
